ayahs.ar: الٓرٰࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Hakeem
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book

ayahs.ar: اَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا اَنۡ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرِ النَّاسَ وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ لَهُمۡ قَدَمَ صِدۡقٍ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡؕؔ قَالَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: A kaana linnaasi 'aaban an awhainaaa ilaa rajulim minhum an anzirin naasa wa bashshiril lazeena aamanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda Rabbihim; qaalal kaafiroona inna haaza lasaahirum mubeen
ayahs.en: Have the people been amazed that We revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their Lord"? [But] the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰي عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ يُدَبِّرُ الۡاَمۡرَؕ مَا مِنۡ شَفِيۡعٍ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اِذۡنِهٖؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna Rabbakumul laahul lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda fee sittati aiyaamin summas tawaa 'alal 'Arshi yudabbirul amra maa min shafee'in illaa mim ba'di iznih; zalikumul laahu Rabbukum fa'budooh; afalaa tazakkaroon
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember?

ayahs.ar: اِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ جَمِيۡعًاؕ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقًّاؕ اِنَّهٗ يَبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ لِيَجۡزِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ بِالۡقِسۡطِؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَهُمۡ شَرَابٌ مِّنۡ حَمِيۡمٍ وَّعَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ilaihi marji'ukum jamee 'anw wa'dal laahi haqqaa; innahoo yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'eeduhoo liyajziyal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati bilqist; wallazeena kafaroo lahum sharaabum min hamee minw wa 'azaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
ayahs.en: To Him is your return all together. [It is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. Indeed, He begins the [process of] creation and then repeats it that He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds, in justice. But those who disbelieved will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ ضِيَآءً وَّالۡقَمَرَ نُوۡرًا وَّقَدَّرَهٗ مَنَازِلَ لِتَعۡلَمُوۡا عَدَدَ السِّنِيۡنَ وَالۡحِسَابَؕ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ ذٰلِكَ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّۚ يُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee ja'alash shamsa diyaaa'anw walqamara nooranw wa qaddarahoo manaaz zila lita'lamoo 'adadas sineena walhisaab; maa khalaqal laahu zaalika illa bilhaqq; yufassilul aayaati liqawminw ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِي اخۡتِلَافِ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fikh tilaafil laili wannahaari wa maa khalaqal laahu fis samaawaati wal ardi la Aayaatil liqawminy yattaqoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and [in] what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear Allah

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا وَرَضُوۡا بِالۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَاطۡمَاَنُّوۡا بِهَا وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا غٰفِلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena laa yarjoona liqaaa'anaa wa radoo bilhayaatid dunyaa watma annoo bihaa wallazeena hum 'an Aayaatinaa ghaafiloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ مَاۡوٰىهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika maawaahumun Naaru bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ يَهۡدِيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ بِاِيۡمَانِهِمۡۚ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ فِيۡ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati yahdeehim Rabbuhum bi eemaanihim tajree min tahtihimul anhaaru fee jannaatin Na'eem
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure

ayahs.ar: دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبۡحٰنَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا سَلٰمٌۚ وَاٰخِرُ دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ اَنِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Da'waahum feehaa Subbaanakal laahumma wa tahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam; wa aakhiru da'waahum anil hamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allah," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds!"

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ يُعَجِّلُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسۡتِعۡجَالَهُمۡ بِالۡخَيۡرِ لَقُضِيَ اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَجَلُهُمۡؕ فَنَذَرُ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا فِيۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law yu'aijilul laahu linnaasish sharras ti'jaalahum bilkhairi laqudiya ilaihim ajaluhum fanazarul lazeena laa yarjoona liqaaa'anna fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
ayahs.en: And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا مَسَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنۭۡ بِهٖ٘ اَوۡ قَاعِدًا اَوۡ قَآئِمًاۚ فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُ ضُرَّهٗ مَرَّ كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَدۡعُنَا٘ اِلٰي ضُرٍّ مَّسَّهٗؕ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa massal insaanad durru da'aanaa lijambiheee aw qaa'idan aw qaaa'iman falammaa kashafnaa 'anhu durrahoo marra ka al lam yad'unaaa ilaa durrim massah; kazaalika zuyyina lilmusrifeena maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡقُرُوۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوۡاۙ وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَمَا كَانُوۡا لِيُؤۡمِنُوۡاؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡقَوۡمَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ahlaknal quroona min qablikum lammaa zalamoo wa jaaa'at hum Rusuluhum bil baiyinaati wa maa kaanoo liyu'minoo; kazaalika najzil qawmal mujrimeen
ayahs.en: And We had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰكُمۡ خَلٰٓئِفَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لِنَنۡظُرَ كَيۡفَ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa ja'alnaakum khalaaa'ifa fil ardi mim ba'dihim linanzura kaifa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيَاتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا ائۡتِ بِقُرۡاٰنٍ غَيۡرِ هٰذَا٘ اَوۡ بَدِّلۡهُؕ قُلۡ مَا يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ٘ اَنۡ اُبَدِّلَهٗ مِنۡ تِلۡقَآئِ نَفۡسِيۡۚ اِنۡ اَتَّبِعُ اِلَّا مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّۚ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّيۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena laa yarjoona liqaaa'ana'ti bi Quraanin ghairi haazaaa aw baddilh; qul maa yakoonu leee an ubaddilahoo min tilqaaa'i nafsee in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaaa ilaiya inneee akhaafu in 'asaytu Rabbee 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeeem
ayahs.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Bring us a Qur'an other than this or change it." Say, [O Muhammad], "It is not for me to change it on my own accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَلَوۡتُهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَدۡرٰىكُمۡ بِهٖࣗؗۖ فَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُ فِيۡكُمۡ عُمُرًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul law shaaa'al laahu maa talawtuhoo 'alaikum wa laaa adraakum bihee faqad labistu feekum 'umuram min qablih; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: Say, "If Allah had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason?"

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِاٰيٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman azlamu mimmanif taraa 'alal laahi kaziban aw kazzaba bi Aayaatih; innahoo laa yuflihul mujrimoon
ayahs.en: So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed

ayahs.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ شُفَعَآؤُنَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ قُلۡ اَتُنَبِّـُٔوۡنَ اللّٰهَ بِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yadurruhum wa laa yanfa'uhum wa yaqooloona haaa'ulaaa'i shufa'aaa 'unaa 'indal laah; qul atunabbi 'oonal laaha bima laa ya'lamu fis samaawaati wa laa fil ard; subhaanahoo wa Ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: And they worship other than Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, "These are our intercessors with Allah " Say, "Do you inform Allah of something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?" Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ اِلَّا٘ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاخۡتَلَفُوۡاؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِيۡمَا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaanan naasu illaaa ummmatanw waahidatan fakh talafoo; wa law laa kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika laqudiya bainahum fee maa feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: And mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ.

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ اٰيَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖۚ فَقُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡغَيۡبُ لِلّٰهِ فَانۡتَظِرُوۡاۚ اِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُنۡتَظِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: W yaqooloona law laaa unzila 'alaihi aayatum mir Rabbihee faqul innamal ghaibu lillaahi fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal muntazireen
ayahs.en: And they say, "Why is a sign not sent down to him from his Lord?" So say, "The unseen is only for Allah [to administer], so wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَذَقۡنَا النَّاسَ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُمۡ اِذَا لَهُمۡ مَّكۡرٌ فِيۡ٘ اٰيَاتِنَاؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُ اَسۡرَعُ مَكۡرًاؕ اِنَّ رُسُلَنَا يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ مَا تَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaaa azaqnan naasa rahmatam mim ba'di darraaa'a massat hum izaa lahum makrun feee aayaatinaa; qulil laahu asra'u makraa; inna rusulanaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon
ayahs.en: And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allah is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers record that which you conspire

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُسَيِّرُكُمۡ فِي الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا كُنۡتُمۡ فِي الۡفُلۡكِۚ وَجَرَيۡنَ بِهِمۡ بِرِيۡحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ وَّفَرِحُوۡا بِهَا جَآءَتۡهَا رِيۡحٌ عَاصِفٌ وَّجَآءَهُمُ الۡمَوۡجُ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَّظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ اُحِيۡطَ بِهِمۡۙ دَعَوُا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ ࣢ۚ لَئِنۡ اَنۡجَيۡتَنَا مِنۡ هٰذِهٖ لَنَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee yusaiyirukum fil barri walbahri hattaaa izaa kuntum fil fulki wa jaraina bihim bireeh in taiyibatinw wa farihoo bihaa jaaa'at haa reehun 'aasifunw wa jaaa'ahumul mawju min kulli makaaninw wa zannooo annahum uheeta bihim da'awul laaha mukhliseena lahud deena la'in anjaitanaa min haazihee lanakoonannna minash shaakireen
ayahs.en: It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating Allah, sincere to Him in religion, "If You should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡجٰىهُمۡ اِذَا هُمۡ يَبۡغُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّؕ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنَّمَا بَغۡيُكُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِكُمۡۙ مَّتَاعَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؗ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa anjaahum izaa hum yabghoona fil ardi bighairil haqq; yaaa aiyuhannaasu innamaa bagh yukum 'alaaa anfusikum mataa'al hayaatid dunyaa summa ilainaa marji'ukum fanunabbi 'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: But when He saves them, at once they commit injustice upon the earth without right. O mankind, your injustice is only against yourselves, [being merely] the enjoyment of worldly life. Then to Us is your return, and We will inform you of what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخۡتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الۡاَرۡضِ مِمَّا يَاۡكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالۡاَنۡعَامُؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَخَذَتِ الۡاَرۡضُ زُخۡرُفَهَا وَازَّيَّنَتۡ وَظَنَّ اَهۡلُهَا٘ اَنَّهُمۡ قٰدِرُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا٘ۙ اَتٰىهَا٘ اَمۡرُنَا لَيۡلًا اَوۡ نَهَارًا فَجَعَلۡنٰهَا حَصِيۡدًا كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ تَغۡنَ بِالۡاَمۡسِؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa masalul hayaatid dunyaa kammaaa'in anzalnaahu minas sammaaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul ardi mimmaa yaakulun naasu wal an'aam; hattaaa izaaa akhazatil ardu zukhrufahaa wazziyanat wa zanna ahluhaaa annahum qaadiroona 'alaihaaa ataahaaa amrunaa lailan aw nahaaran faja'alnaahaa haseedan ka allam taghna bil-ams; kazaalika nufassilul aayaati liqawminy yatafakkaroon
ayahs.en: The example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it Our command by night or by day, and We make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do We explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ يَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي دَارِ السَّلٰمِؕ وَيَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu yad'ooo ilaa daaris salaami wa yahdee mai yashaaa'u ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path

ayahs.ar: لِلَّذِيۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوا الۡحُسۡنٰي وَزِيَادَةٌؕ وَلَا يَرۡهَقُ وُجُوۡهَهُمۡ قَتَرٌ وَّلَا ذِلَّةٌؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lillazeena ahsanul husnaa wa ziyaadahtunw wa laa yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarunw wa laa zillah; ulaaa'ika ashaabul jannnati hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: For them who have done good is the best [reward] and extra. No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَسَبُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةٍۭ بِمِثۡلِهَاۙ وَتَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٍۚ كَاَنَّمَا٘ اُغۡشِيَتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ قِطَعًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ مُظۡلِمًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kasabus saiyi aati jazaaa'u saiyi'atim bimislihaa wa tarhaquhum zillah; maa lahum minal laahi min 'aasimin ka annamaaa ughshiyat wujoohuhum qita 'am minal laili muzlimaa; ulaaa'ika Ashaabun Naari hum feeha khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But they who have earned [blame for] evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. They will have from Allah no protector. It will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark [are they]. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ نَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡا مَكَانَكُمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ وَشُرَكَآؤُكُمۡۚ فَزَيَّلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَقَالَ شُرَكَآؤُهُمۡ مَّا كُنۡتُمۡ اِيَّانَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma nahshuruhum jamee'an summa naqoolu lillazeena ashrakoo makaanakum antum wa shurakaaa'ukum; fazaiyalnaa bainahum wa qaala shurakaaa'uhum maa kuntum iyyaanaa ta'budoon
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "[Remain in] your place, you and your 'partners.' " Then We will separate them, and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us,

ayahs.ar: فَكَفٰي بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيۡدًاۭ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنَّا عَنۡ عِبَادَتِكُمۡ لَغٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakafaa billaahi shaheedam bainanaa wa bainakum in kunnaa 'an 'ibaadatikum laghaafileen
ayahs.en: And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware."

ayahs.ar: هُنَالِكَ تَبۡلُوۡا كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا٘ اَسۡلَفَتۡ وَرُدُّوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَوۡلٰىهُمُ الۡحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Hunaalika tabloo kullu nafsim maaa aslafat; wa ruddoo ilal laahi mawlaahu mul haqqi wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: There, [on that Day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah, their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اَمَّنۡ يَّمۡلِكُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَمَنۡ يُّخۡرِجُ الۡحَيَّ مِنَ الۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ الۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَيِّ وَمَنۡ يُّدَبِّرُ الۡاَمۡرَؕ فَسَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اللّٰهُۚ فَقُلۡ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul mai yarzuqukum minas samaaa'i wal ardi ammany yamlikus sam'a wal absaara wa mai yukhrijul haiya minal maiyiti wa yikhrijul maiyita minal haiyi wa mai yudabbirul amr; fasa yaqooloonal laah; faqul afalaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges [every] matter?" They will say, "Allah," so say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.ar: فَذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمُ الۡحَقُّۚ فَمَا ذَا بَعۡدَ الۡحَقِّ اِلَّا الضَّلٰلُۚ فَاَنّٰي تُصۡرَفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fazaalikumul laahu Rabbukumul haqq; famaazaa ba'dal haqqi illad dalaalu fa annnaa tusrafoon
ayahs.en: For that is Allah, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ فَسَقُوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika haqqat Kalimatu Rabbika 'alal lazeena fasaqooo annahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Thus the word of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ مِنۡ شُرَكَآئِكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُ يَبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ فَاَنّٰي تُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul hal min shurakaaa 'ikum mai yabda'ul khalqa suma yu'eeduh; qulil laahu yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'eeduhoo fa annaa tu'fakoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ مِنۡ شُرَكَآئِكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَي الۡحَقِّؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُ يَهۡدِيۡ لِلۡحَقِّؕ اَفَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَي الۡحَقِّ اَحَقُّ اَنۡ يُّتَّبَعَ اَمَّنۡ لَّا يَهِدِّيۡ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّهۡدٰيۚ فَمَا لَكُمۡࣞ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul hal min shurakaaa 'ikum mai yahdeee ilal haqq; qulil laahu yahdee lilhaqq; afamai yahdeee ilal haqqi ahaqqu ai yuttaba'a ammal laa yahiddeee illaaa ai yuhdaa famaa lakum kaifa tahkumoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" Say, "Allah guides to the truth. So is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? Then what is [wrong] with you - how do you judge?"

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ اِلَّا ظَنًّاؕ اِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِيۡ مِنَ الۡحَقِّ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yattabi'u aksaruhum illaa zannaa; innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa; innal laaha 'Aleemum bimaa yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: And most of them follow not except assumption. Indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ اَنۡ يُّفۡتَرٰي مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنۡ تَصۡدِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣞ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana haazal Quraanu ai yuftaraa min doonil laahi wa laakin tasdeeqal lazee baina yadaihi wa tafseelal Kitaabi laa raiba fee mir Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And it was not [possible] for this Qur'an to be produced by other than Allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِسُوۡرَةٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ وَادۡعُوۡا مَنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul faatoo bisooratim mislihee wad'oo manis tata'tum min doonil laahi in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Or do they say [about the Prophet], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a surah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِمَا لَمۡ يُحِيۡطُوۡا بِعِلۡمِهٖ وَلَمَّا يَاۡتِهِمۡ تَاۡوِيۡلُهٗؕ كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal kazzaboo bimaa lam yuheetoo bi'ilmihee wa lammaa yaatihim taaweeluh; kazaalika kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatuz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِهٖ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهٖؕ وَرَبُّكَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa minhum mai yu 'minu bihee wa minhum mal laa yu'minu bih; wa Rabbuka a'lamu bilmufsideen
ayahs.en: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ كَذَّبُوۡكَ فَقُلۡ لِّيۡ عَمَلِيۡ وَلَكُمۡ عَمَلُكُمۡۚ اَنۡتُمۡ بَرِيۡٓـُٔوۡنَ مِمَّا٘ اَعۡمَلُ وَاَنَا بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in kazzabooka faqul lee 'amalee wa lakum 'amalukum antum bareee'oona mimmaaa a'malu wa ana bareee'um mimmaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ وَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa minhum mai yastami'oona iliak; afa anta tusmi'us summa wa law kaanoo la ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason?

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّنۡظُرُ اِلَيۡكَؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تَهۡدِي الۡعُمۡيَ وَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa minhum mai yanzuru ilaik; afa anta tahdil 'umya wa law kaanoo laa yubsiroon
ayahs.en: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَظۡلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلٰكِنَّ النَّاسَ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha laa yazlimun naasa shai'anw wa laakin nannaasa anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَلۡبَثُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنَ النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ قَدۡ خَسِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِلِقَآءِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yahshuruhum ka al lam yalbasooo illaa saa'atam minan nahaari yata'aarafoona bainahum; qad khasiral lazeena kazzaboo biliqaaa'il laahi wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen
ayahs.en: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided

ayahs.ar: وَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ نَعِدُهُمۡ اَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ اللّٰهُ شَهِيۡدٌ عَلٰي مَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa imma nuriyannaka ba'dal lazee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa ilainaa marji'uhum summal laahu shaheedun 'alaa maa yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muhammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allah is a witness concerning what they are doing

ayahs.ar: وَلِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوۡلٌۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ رَسُوۡلُهُمۡ قُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa likulli ummatir Rasoolun fa izaa jaaa'a Rasooluhum qudiya bainahum bilqisti wa hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّا٘ اَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِيۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًا اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ لِكُلِّ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلٌؕ اِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul laaa amliku linafsee darranw wa laa naf'an illaa maa shaaa'al laah; likulli ummatin ajalun izaa jaaa'a ajaluhum falaaa yastaakhiroona saa'a tanw wa laa yastaqdimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allah should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَتٰىكُمۡ عَذَابُهٗ بَيَاتًا اَوۡ نَهَارًا مَّاذَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ مِنۡهُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aitum in ataakum 'azaabuhoo bayaatan aw nahaaram maazaa yasta'jilu minhul mujrimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"

ayahs.ar: اَثُمَّ اِذَا مَا وَقَعَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِهٖؕ آٰلۡـٰٔنَ وَقَدۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Asumma izaa maa waqa'a aamantum bih; aaal'aana wa qad kuntum bihee tasta'jiloon
ayahs.en: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قِيۡلَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ الۡخُلۡدِۚ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa qeela lillazeena zalamoo zooqoo 'azaabal khuld hal tujzawna illaa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
ayahs.en: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?"

ayahs.ar: وَيَسۡتَنۭۡ بِـُٔوۡنَكَ اَحَقٌّ هُوَؕؔ قُلۡ اِيۡ وَرَبِّيۡ٘ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّؕؔ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yastambi'oonaka ahaqqun huwa qul ee wa Rabbeee innahoo lahaqq; wa maaa antum bimu'jizeen
ayahs.en: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]."

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفۡسٍ ظَلَمَتۡ مَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ لَافۡتَدَتۡ بِهٖؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law anna likulli nafsin zalamat maa fil ardi laftadat bih; wa asarrun nadaamata lammaa ra awul 'azaab, wa qudiya bainahum bilqist; wa hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alaaa inna lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wal ard; alaaa inna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth, but most of them do not know

ayahs.ar: هُوَ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu wailaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكُمۡ مَّوۡعِظَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُوۡرِ ࣢ۙ وَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhan naasu qad jaaa'atkum maw 'izatum mir Rabbikum wa shifaaa'ul limaa fis sudoori wa hudanw wa rahmatul lilmu'mineen
ayahs.en: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ بِفَضۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَبِرَحۡمَتِهٖ فَبِذٰلِكَ فَلۡيَفۡرَحُوۡاؕ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul bifadlil laahi wa birahmatihii fabizaalika falyaf rahoo huwa khairum mimmaa yajma'oon
ayahs.en: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ مَّا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّزۡقٍ فَجَعَلۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ حَرَامًا وَّحَلٰلًاؕ قُلۡ آٰللّٰهُ اَذِنَ لَكُمۡ اَمۡ عَلَي اللّٰهِ تَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aitum maaa anzalal laahu lakum mir rizqin faja'altum minhu haraamanw wa halaalan qul aaallaahu azina lakum am 'alal laahi taftaroon
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allah?"

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa zannul lazeena yaftaroona 'alal laahil kaziba Yawmal Qiyaamah; innal laaha lazoo fadlin 'alan naasi wa laakinna aksarahum laa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allah on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not grateful."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَكُوۡنُ فِيۡ شَاۡنٍ وَّمَا تَتۡلُوۡا مِنۡهُ مِنۡ قُرۡاٰنٍ وَّلَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مِنۡ عَمَلٍ اِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيۡكُمۡ شُهُوۡدًا اِذۡ تُفِيۡضُوۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ وَمَا يَعۡزُبُ عَنۡ رَّبِّكَ مِنۡ مِّثۡقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِ وَلَا٘ اَصۡغَرَ مِنۡ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا٘ اَكۡبَرَ اِلَّا فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa takoonu fee shaaninw wa maa tatloo minhu min quraaninw wa laa ta'maloona min 'amalin illaa kunnaa 'alaikum shuhoodan iz tufeedoona feeh; wa maa ya'zubu 'ar Rabbika mim mis qaali zarratin fil ardi wa laa fis samaaa'i wa laaa asghara min zaalika wa laaa akbara illaa fee Kitaabim Mubeen
ayahs.en: And, [O Muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the Qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register.

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّ اَوۡلِيَآءَ اللّٰهِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Alaa innaa awliyaaa'al laahi laa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahzanoon
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
ayahs.en: Those who believed and were fearing Allah

ayahs.ar: لَهُمُ الۡبُشۡرٰي فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَفِي الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ لَا تَبۡدِيۡلَ لِكَلِمٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Lahumul bushraa filha yaatid dunyaa wa fil Aakhirah; laa tabdeela likalimaatil laah; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem
ayahs.en: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ اِنَّ الۡعِزَّةَ لِلّٰهِ جَمِيۡعًاؕ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yahzunka qawluhum; innal 'izzata lillaahi jamee'aa; Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ شُرَكَآءَؕ اِنۡ يَّتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَاِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alaaa inna lillaahi man fis samaawaati wa man fil ard; wa maa yattabi'ul lazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi shurakaaa'; iny yattabi'oona illaz zannna wa in hum illaa yakhrusoon
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allah do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul laila litaskunoo feehi wannahaara mubsiraa; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqawmai yasma'oon
ayahs.en: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًا سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ هُوَ الۡغَنِيُّؕ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنۡ عِنۡدَكُمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍۭ بِهٰذَاؕ اَتَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalut takhazal laahu waladan Subhaanahoo Huwal Ghaniyyu lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ard; in 'indakum min sultaanim bihaazaaa; ataqooloona 'alal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: They have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul innal lazeena yaftaroona 'alal laahil kaziba laa yuflihoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed."

ayahs.ar: مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ اِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ نُذِيۡقُهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ الشَّدِيۡدَ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡفُرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Mataa'un fiddunyaa summa ilainaa marji'uhum summa nuzeequhumul 'azaabash shadeeda bimaa kaanoo yakkfuroon
ayahs.en: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

ayahs.ar: وَاتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَاَ نُوۡحٍۘ اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنۡ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مَّقَامِيۡ وَتَذۡكِيۡرِيۡ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَعَلَي اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ فَاَجۡمِعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَكُمۡ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنۡ اَمۡرُكُمۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ اقۡضُوۡ٘ا اِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a-Noohin iz qaala liqawmihee yaa qawmi in kaana kabura 'alaikum maqaamee wa tazkeeree bi Aayaatil laahi fa'alal laahi tawakkaltu fa ajmi'ooo amrakum wa shurakaaa'akum summa laa yakun amrukum 'alaikum ghummatan summmaq dooo ilaiya wa laa tunziroon
ayahs.en: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allah has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allah. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَمَا سَاَلۡتُكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَجۡرٍؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِۙ وَاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa in tawallaitum famaa sa altukum min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alal laahi wa umirtu an akoona minal muslimeen
ayahs.en: And if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ خَلٰٓئِفَ وَاَغۡرَقۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۚ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fanajjainaahu wa mamm'ahoo fil fulki wa ja'alnaahum khalaaa'ifa wa aghraqnal lazeena kazzaboo bi aayaatinaa fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul munzareen
ayahs.en: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ رُسُلًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوۡهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوۡا لِيُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِمَا كَذَّبُوۡا بِهٖ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَطۡبَعُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِ الۡمُعۡتَدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summma ba'asnaa mim ba'dihee Rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaaa'oohum bilbaiyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kazzaboo bihee min qabl; kazaalika natba'u 'alaa quloobil mu'tadeen
ayahs.en: Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ مُّوۡسٰي وَهٰرُوۡنَ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa ba'asnaa mim ba'dihim Moosaa Wa Haaroona ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee bi aayaatinaa fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawmam mujrimeen
ayahs.en: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu min 'indinaa qaalooo inna haazaa lasihrum mubeen
ayahs.en: So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَتَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لِلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمۡؕ اَسِحۡرٌ هٰذَاؕ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ السّٰحِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalaa Moosaaa ataqooloona lilhaqqi lammmaa jaaa'a kum asihrun haazaa wa laa yuflihus saabiroon
ayahs.en: Moses said, "Do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا لِتَلۡفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَنَا وَتَكُوۡنَ لَكُمَا الۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo aji'tanaa litalfitanaa 'ammaa wajadnaa 'alaihi aabaaa'anaa wa takoona lakumal kibriyaaa'u fil ardi wa maa nahnu lakumaa bimu' mineen
ayahs.en: They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِكُلِّ سٰحِرٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Fir'awnu' toonee bikulli saahirin 'aleem
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰ٘ي اَلۡقُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'assa haratu qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon
ayahs.en: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَلۡقَوۡا قَالَ مُوۡسٰي مَا جِئۡتُمۡ بِهِۙ السِّحۡرُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَيُبۡطِلُهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُصۡلِحُ عَمَلَ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa alqaw qaala Moosaa maa ji'tum bihis sihru innal laaha sa yubtiluhoo innal laaha laa yuslihu 'amalal mufsideen
ayahs.en: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters.

ayahs.ar: وَيُحِقُّ اللّٰهُ الۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yuhiqqul laahul haqqa bi Kalimaatihee wa law karihal mujrimoon
ayahs.en: And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."

ayahs.ar: فَمَا٘ اٰمَنَ لِمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ عَلٰي خَوۡفٍ مِّنۡ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهِمۡ اَنۡ يَّفۡتِنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لَعَالٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚ وَاِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Famaaa aamana li-Moosaaa illaa zurriyyatum min qawmihee 'alaa khawfim min Fir'awna wa mala'ihim ai yaftinahum; wa inna Fir'awna la'aalin fil ardi wa innahoo laminal musrifeen
ayahs.en: But no one believed Moses, except [some] youths among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰي يٰقَوۡمِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ فَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Moosaa yaa qawmi in kuntum aamantum billaahi fa'alaihi tawakkalooo in kuntum muslimeen
ayahs.en: And Moses said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allah, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims."

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةً لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqaaloo 'alal laahi tawakkalnaa Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lilqawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

ayahs.ar: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِكَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa najjinaa birahmatika minal qawmil kaafireen
ayahs.en: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰي وَاَخِيۡهِ اَنۡ تَبَوَّاٰ لِقَوۡمِكُمَا بِمِصۡرَ بُيُوۡتًا وَّاجۡعَلُوۡا بُيُوۡتَكُمۡ قِبۡلَةً وَّاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَؕ وَبَشِّرِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaa wa akheehi an tabaw wa aa liqawmikuma bi Misra bu yootanw waj'aloo bu yootakum qiblatanw wa aqeemus Salaah; wa bashshiril mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰي رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّكَ اٰتَيۡتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَاَهٗ زِيۡنَةً وَّاَمۡوَالًا فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۙ رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِكَۚ رَبَّنَا اطۡمِسۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡوَالِهِمۡ وَاشۡدُدۡ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ فَلَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡا حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Mosaa Rabbanaaa innaka aataita Fir'awna wa mala ahoo zeenatanw wa amwaalan fil hayaatid dunyaa Rabbanaa liyudillo 'ansabeelika Rabbanat mis 'alaaa amwaalihim washdud 'alaa quloobihim falaa yu'minoo hatta yarawul 'azaabal aleem
ayahs.en: And Moses said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead [men] astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ اُجِيۡبَتۡ دَّعۡوَتُكُمَا فَاسۡتَقِيۡمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعٰٓنِّ سَبِيۡلَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala qad ujeebad da'watukumaa fastaqeemaa wa laa tattabi'aaanni sabeelal lazeena laaya'lamoon
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."

ayahs.ar: وَجٰوَزۡنَا بِبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡبَحۡرَ فَاَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗ بَغۡيًا وَّعَدۡوًاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَدۡرَكَهُ الۡغَرَقُ قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنَتۡ بِهٖ بَنُوۡ٘ا اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ وَاَنَا مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaawaznaa bi Baneee Israaa'eelal bahra fa atba'ahum Fir'awnu wa junooduhoo baghyanw wa 'adwan hattaaa izaaa adrakahul gharaqu qaala aamantu annnahoo laaa ilaaha illal lazeee aamanat bihee Banooo Israaa'eela wa ana minal muslimeen
ayahs.en: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."

ayahs.ar: آٰلۡـٰٔنَ وَقَدۡ عَصَيۡتَ قَبۡلُ وَكُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Aaal'aana wa qad 'asaita qablu wa kunta minal mufsideen
ayahs.en: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters?

ayahs.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ نُنَجِّيۡكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُوۡنَ لِمَنۡ خَلۡفَكَ اٰيَةًؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا لَغٰفِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Falyawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka Aayah; wa inna kaseeram minan naasi 'an aayaatinaa laghaafiloon
ayahs.en: So today We will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ بَوَّاۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ مُبَوَّاَ صِدۡقٍ وَّرَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِۚ فَمَا اخۡتَلَفُوۡا حَتّٰي جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِيۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad bawwaanaa Baneee Israaa'eela mubawwa-a sidqinw wa razaqnaahum minnat taiyibaati famakh talafoo hattaa jaaa'ahmul 'ilm; inna Rabbaka yaqdee bainahum Yawmal Qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: And We had certainty settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ كُنۡتَ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ فَسۡـَٔلِ الَّذِيۡنَ يَقۡرَءُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۚ لَقَدۡ جَآءَكَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُمۡتَرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa in kunta fee shakkim mimmaaa anzalnaaa ilaika fas'alil lazeena yaqra'oonal Kitaaba min qablik; laqad jaaa'akal haqqu mir Rabbika falaa takoonanna minal mumtareen
ayahs.en: So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa takoonanna minal lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatil laahi fatakoona minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena haqqat 'alaihim Kalimatu Rabbika laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe,

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ كُلُّ اٰيَةٍ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law jaaa'at hum kullu Aayatin hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem
ayahs.en: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَتۡ قَرۡيَةٌ اٰمَنَتۡ فَنَفَعَهَا٘ اِيۡمَانُهَا٘ اِلَّا قَوۡمَ يُوۡنُسَؕۚ لَمَّا٘ اٰمَنُوۡا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡخِزۡيِ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَمَتَّعۡنٰهُمۡ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Falaw laa kaanat qaryatun aamanat fanafa'ahaaa eemaanuhaaa illaa qawma Yoonusa lammaaa aamanoo kashafnaa 'anhum 'azaabal khizyi fil hayaatid dunyaa wa matta'naahum ilaa heen
ayahs.en: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَاٰمَنَ مَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ كُلُّهُمۡ جَمِيۡعًاؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تُكۡرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰي يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law shaaa'a Rabbuka la aamana man fil ardi kulluhum jamee'aa; afa anta tukrihun naasa hattaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفۡسٍ اَنۡ تُؤۡمِنَ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَيَجۡعَلُ الرِّجۡسَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana linafsin an tu'mina illaa bi iznil laah; wa yaj'alur rijsa 'alal lazeena laa ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ انۡظُرُوۡا مَاذَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَا تُغۡنِي الۡاٰيٰتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَنۡ قَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qulin zuroo maazaa fissamaawaati wal ard; wa maa tughnil Aayaatu wannuzuru 'an qawmil laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe

ayahs.ar: فَهَلۡ يَنۡتَظِرُوۡنَ اِلَّا مِثۡلَ اَيَّامِ الَّذِيۡنَ خَلَوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ قُلۡ فَانۡتَظِرُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُنۡتَظِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fahal yantaziroona illaa misla ayyaamil lazeena khalaw min qablihim; qul fantazirooo innee ma'akum minal muntazireen
ayahs.en: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّيۡ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا كَذٰلِكَۚ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نُنۡجِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summma nunajjee Ruslanaa wallazeena aamanoo; kazaalika haqqan 'alainaa nunjil mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Then We will save our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡ دِيۡنِيۡ فَلَا٘ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِيۡنَ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنۡ اَعۡبُدُ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيۡ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمۡۚۖ وَاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul yaaa ayyuhan naasu in kuntum fee shakkkim min deenee falaa a'budul lazeena ta'budoona min doonil laahi wa laakin a'budul laahal lazee yatawaffaakum wa umirtu an akoona minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡ اَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ حَنِيۡفًاۚ وَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa an aqim wajhaka liddeeni Haneefanw wa laa takoonannna minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah;

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَۚ فَاِنۡ فَعَلۡتَ فَاِنَّكَ اِذًا مِّنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tad'u min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'uka wa laa yadurruka fa in fa'alta fa innaka izam minaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And do not invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers.'"

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّمۡسَسۡكَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهٗ٘ اِلَّا هُوَۚ وَاِنۡ يُّرِدۡكَ بِخَيۡرٍ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضۡلِهٖؕ يُصِيۡبُ بِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖؕ وَهُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa iny yamsaskal laahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahoo illaa Huwa wa iny yuridka bikhairin falaa raaadda lifadlih; yuseebu bihee man yashaaa'u min 'ibaadih; wa huwal Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُمُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰي فَاِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِيۡ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاؕ وَمَا٘ اَنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِوَكِيۡلٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul yaaa aiyuhan naasu qad jaaa'akumul haqqu mir Rabbikum famanih tadaa fa innamaa yahtadee linafsihee wa man dalla fa innamaa yadillu 'alaihaa wa maaa ana 'alaikum biwakeel
ayahs.en: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager."

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّبِعۡ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَاصۡبِرۡ حَتّٰي يَحۡكُمَ اللّٰهُۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qattabi' maa yoohaaa ilaika wasbir hattaa yahkumal laah; wa Huwa khairul haakimeen
ayahs.en: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges.
